description: Verify build, run tests, and validate security implementations: ensure full build succeeds, unit tests pass, integration tests pass (with test database), verify authentication flows work, confirm rate limiting functions, validate input sanitization, check audit logging, and document verification results.
steps: 1. Run full verification suite: npm run verify (prisma generate + typecheck + lint + tests + build). Fix any remaining issues discovered.
2. If TEST_DATABASE_URL available, run integration tests: npm run test:integration. Document results or skip with note if no test DB configured.

3. Manual security verification checklist: (a) Start dev server npm run dev, (b) Test login with wrong password - verify lockout after 5 attempts, (c) Test password reset flow - verify token single-use, (d) Test rate limiting on /login with rapid requests, (e) Test session expiry and re-authentication, (f) Test that deactivated user cannot login, (g) Test CSRF protection by attempting action without proper origin, (h) Check that secrets are redacted in logs, (i) Verify SQL injection protection by testing lead search with quotes/SQL, (j) Test XSS by creating lead with <script> in notes field, (k) Test that out-of-scope lead IDs return 404 not 403.

4. Review and document findings: Create .agents/tasks/security-audit/verification-results.md with: (a) All tests run and results, (b) Security checklist completion status, (c) Any issues found and their severity, (d) Remaining known limitations from docs/SECURITY.md, (e) Recommendations for further testing (penetration test, load test, accessibility audit).
5. Update docs/TESTING.md to reflect that build and tests have now been run, update status from 'never run' to actual results.

6. Create summary of all changes made across FEAT-001 through FEAT-004 in .agents/tasks/security-audit/CHANGES.md listing: (a) TypeScript errors fixed, (b) Dependencies updated with versions, (c) Security enhancements added, (d) Tests executed, (e) Breaking changes (if any), (f) Migration notes for deployment.
7. Run final npm audit and document any remaining low/moderate issues with justification or plan to address.

8. Verify application starts and basic functionality works: npm run dev, access http://localhost:3000, login as admin@crm.test (from SEED_DEV_PASSWORD), navigate to dashboard, leads, team pages to ensure no runtime errors.
acceptance_criteria: npm run verify completes successfully with all checks passing
npm run build produces production bundle without errors
npm test passes all unit tests
Integration tests pass or documented as skipped with reason
Manual security checklist completed with all critical items verified
Application starts without errors and basic pages render
All changes documented in verification results and change summary
Remaining security considerations documented with mitigation plans
verification: npm run build — must exit 0 and create .next/standalone
npm test — must pass all unit tests
npm run dev must start without fatal errors
Manual login test must succeed with seed credentials
